tool_input.command:
cd /workspace/task && python3 -c "
import openpyxl
wb = openpyxl.load_workbook('init.xlsx')
ws = wb['Consolidated Tracker']
rows = []
existing = wb['Existing Task']
additions = wb['Additions']
retired = wb['Retired']
for r in range(3, existing.max_row+1):
    rows.append([existing.cell(r,c).value for c in range(1,6)])
for r in range(3, additions.max_row+1):
    rows.append([additions.cell(r,c).value for c in range(1,6)])
for r in range(3, retired.max_row+1):
    rows.append([retired.cell(r,c).value for c in range(1,6)])
for i,row in enumerate(rows):
    ws.cell(3+i,1).value = row[0]
    ws.cell(3+i,2).value = row[1]
    ws.cell(3+i,3).value = row[2]
    ws.cell(3+i,4).value = row[3]
    ws.cell(3+i,5).value = row[4]
wb.save('output.xlsx')
print('done')
"
